title: Frappe: linked data must preserve document and field permissions
summary: CVE-2026-39351 concerns related-document expansion in a REST response. Frappe loaded linked records without checking the caller’s permission and serialized them without field filtering. The research identifies disclosure of otherwise inaccessible documents in tested version 15.96.0.
defensive_use: Editorial lesson: authorization on a parent object cannot authorize every object reachable from it. Define response contracts that preserve both per-document access and field visibility during expansion. The maintainer advisory identifies patched releases 15.104.0 and 16.14.0; it does not describe the patch implementation.

access.note: Public sources readable without an account.

freshness.note: Primary research and maintainer evidence reviewed. Article immutability and deployment remediation were not established.

sources.title: GHSL-2026-012: Unauthorized Data Exposure via REST API Link Expansion in Frappe - CVE-2026-39351
Unrestricted Doctype access via API exploit

caveats: Requires a readable parent document whose expanded links reach records the caller cannot otherwise access; it does not establish unrestricted access to every document.
The publication explains the code-level disclosure mechanism but supplies no customer incident or measured data-loss evidence. Do not infer write access or account takeover.
Reported January 19, 2026; maintainer advisory published April 7; detailed research published April 24. Fix-release dates were not established by the reviewed sources.
